boundary: Real production roles/tools/browser/quality/transaction; controlled movement/collection subset, not full CLI ingestion/specification/decomposition or full game
checkpoints: Actual failed receipt/mission or accepted foundation explicitly reused; fresh authorization, never counted as new scripted model evidence
mutation_safety: Context/Impact active; ordinary execution contract null; optional progress-constrained/contract-bound activation not claimed
reproduction_limit: Raw harnesses local-only. Curated evidence review, not portable one-command live reproduction.
complete_acceptance: Successful functional repair/fresh required verification/transaction, or accepted sequential movement/collection with retained duties and complete parent, remain mandatory.
